_comment: Computer Use model recipes for Brazier's Computer workspace mode.
Fara1.5 is Microsoft Research's native computer-use agent family. Models
observe browser (or desktop) screenshots and emit Fara XML <tool_call>
blocks calling computer_use. Brazier parses those into normalized
ComputerAction values and executes them against the selected target.
Serve with vLLM (or another OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint) and register
the endpoint as a remote connection, or place the weights where Brazier's
vLLM runtime can load them. Prefer temperature 0 and at least 15k context
for multi-screenshot trajectories; Fara1.5 natively supports up to 262k.

recipes.label: Fara1.5 4B
recipes.summary: Smallest Fara1.5 CUA. Practical on a single consumer GPU; strong for its size on browser tasks.

notes: Lower --max-model-len (e.g. 32768 or 65536) if VRAM is tight.
Set temperature to 0 for best agent reliability.
Ensure image multimodal limits allow the screenshot history (image=10).

recipes.label: Fara1.5 9B
recipes.summary: Mid-size Fara1.5. Best balance of quality and footprint for most desktop hosts with a single A100-class GPU.

notes: Requires vllm >= 0.19.1 and transformers with Qwen3.5 multimodal support.
262k context needs substantial KV cache; reduce max-model-len on smaller cards.
Temperature 0; keep at least ~15k tokens for multi-step browser tasks.

recipes.label: Fara1.5 27B
recipes.summary: Largest open Fara1.5 CUA. Highest task success; needs multi-GPU or high-VRAM hosts.

notes: Plan for tensor parallel on multi-GPU hosts when VRAM is insufficient for bf16.
Cap context if necessary; agent quality still benefits from ≥15k tokens.
